SIMD and decoder paired measurements, 2026-10-20 Asia/Tokyo
Apple M3; Go 1.27.0; TinyGo 0.42.0 / LLVM 22.1.4; darwin/arm64.
Five 300 ms samples per condition, GOMAXPROCS=1, sequential rotating order.
Zstd Go = force_tinygo_logic; byte-kernel Go = GOEXPERIMENT=simd.
TinyGo uses -opt=z except zstd *-2, which uses -opt=2.
